name: Mozu
source:
Taisho period, Tokyo.... The main character comes back to his hometown from Europe... to revenge on people who betrayed his father and cornered his family to death. He looks for his enemies one by one... and approaches an innocent girl.... I am back to the land of revenge.... The dawn of party....
